shortDescription: Add, update, or remove PostgreSQL subscription

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Specifies the name of a file containing SSL certificate authority (CA) certificate(s). If the file exists, the server's certificate will be verified to be signed by one of these authorities.

options.name: cascade
options.description: Drop subscription dependencies. Has effect with I(state=absent) only. Ignored when I(state) is not C(absent).

options.name: comment
options.description: Sets a comment on the subscription. To reset the comment, pass an empty string.

options.name: connect_params
options.description: Any additional parameters to be passed to libpg. These parameters take precedence.

options.name: connparams
options.description: The connection dict param-value to connect to the publisher. For more information see U(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/libpq-connect.html#LIBPQ-CONNSTRING). Ignored when I(state) is not C(present). Ignored when an existing subscription's connection parameters are not available from the server (such as in CloudSQL).

options.name: login_db
options.description: Name of the database to connect to and where the subscription state will be changed. The V(db) alias is deprecated and will be removed in version 5.0.0.

options.name: login_host
options.description: Host running the database. If you have connection issues when using C(localhost), try to use C(127.0.0.1) instead.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password this module should use to establish its PostgreSQL session.

options.name: login_port
options.description: Database port to connect to. The C(port) alias is deprecated and will be removed in the next major release. Use C(login_port) instead.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: Path to a Unix domain socket for local connections.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username this module should use to establish its PostgreSQL session.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the subscription to add, update, or remove.

options.name: owner
options.description: Subscription owner. If I(owner) is not defined, the owner will be set as I(login_user) or I(session_role). Ignored when I(state) is not C(present).

options.name: publications
options.description: The publication names on the publisher to use for the subscription. Ignored when I(state) is not C(present).

options.name: session_role
options.description: Switch to session_role after connecting. The specified session_role must be a role that the current login_user is a member of. Permissions checking for SQL commands is carried out as though the session_role were the one that had logged in originally.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: Specifies the file name of the client SSL certificate.

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: Specifies the location for the secret key used for the client certificate.

options.name: ssl_mode
options.description: Determines whether or with what priority a secure SSL TCP/IP connection will be negotiated with the server. See U(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/static/libpq-ssl.html) for more information on the modes. Default of C(prefer) matches libpq default.

options.name: state
options.description: The subscription state. C(present) implies that if I(name) subscription doesn't exist, it will be created. C(absent) implies that if I(name) subscription exists, it will be removed. C(refresh) implies that if I(name) subscription exists, it will be refreshed. Fetch missing table information from publisher. Always returns ``changed`` is ``True``. This will start replication of tables that were added to the subscribed-to publications since the last invocation of REFRESH PUBLICATION or since CREATE

options.name: subsparams
options.description: Dictionary of optional parameters for a subscription, e.g. copy_data, enabled, create_slot, etc. For update the subscription allowed keys are C(enabled), C(slot_name), C(synchronous_commit), C(publication_name). See available parameters to create a new subscription on U(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-createsubscription.html). Ignored when I(state) is not C(present).

options.name: trust_input
options.description: If C(false), check whether values of parameters I(name), I(publications), I(owner), I(session_role), I(connparams), I(subsparams) are potentially dangerous. It makes sense to use C(true) only when SQL injections via the parameters are possible.
